confirmation_1.finding: At thresholds 0.05/0.10/0.15 the model gives precision 0.0474, recall 1.0, pos_rate 1.0 -- it predicts positive on every pair.
confirmation_1.significance: Independent prior confirmation of the 2026-08-05 diagnosis (contra_prob AUROC 0.460 vs pharmacist gold). No operating point recovers precision above the 4.0% base rate.

confirmation_2.claim: internal_consistency_kappa = 1.000, described as two independent pharmacist instruments agreeing perfectly, with rebuttal_use = answers the N=1 annotator concern.
confirmation_2.problem: CIRCULAR. A not-contradiction has no danger by definition, so label==contradiction <=> danger_rating>0 is an identity, not an agreement measurement. kappa=1.000 is guaranteed by construction and measures nothing.
confirmation_2.action: Remove from any rebuttal. Reviewers JDYj and p4E8 asked for inter-rater reliability; this would read as evasion. Answer with a second annotator or the severity-ranking reframe.

confirmation_3.claim: Only 2 of 1610 candidates resolved by intermediate notes -- validates the clinical need for automated detection.
confirmation_3.problem: The resolution regex contains both continue and discontinue among 20 alternations, so it matches nearly any medication sentence. 2/1610 is an instrument failure, not a measurement of clinical documentation practice.
